description: Somos el mejor equipo que hay, solo ganadores impostores pueden entrar a este grupo. SI NO ERES UN SUSSY BAKA NO PUEDES ENTRAR. Lo impostor lo agregamos despues entonces no te preocupes si no eres un impostor, eso podemos arreglarlo despues.
summary: In this project we developed a fun game where you gotta manage your resources in order to escape the planet in a spaceship you gotta build.
details:
Our game has the objective to make users learn about spaceship managing in a fun way, for the creation of it we used Godot Engine 4.7 which is an easy-to-use game engine.
Our game also includes a little story so its more entertaining.
